correctness.rationale: The edge-vertex incidence graph has 2n+binom(n,2) vertices and 4binom(n,2) edges, giving cycle rank 3binom(n,2)-2n+1. In rational graph chains, the commuting clone swaps diagonalize: the trivial joint eigenspace is the once-subdivided K_n cycle module wedge² V_n; each single-swap eigenspace has an (n-2)-dimensional sum-zero edge-star kernel, and multi-swap eigenspaces have no edges. For radius two clone pairs have identical closed threshold neighborhoods, so their transpositions are contiguous to identity and can be dominated-collapsed. The core on S(K_n) is contractible by vertex-link deletions; exactly one triangle T_ijk per original triple attaches with its boundary in the core. S_n acts on these triangles by the alternating orientation, giving H2 = wedge³ Q^n with trivial (C2)^n. A clone is a radius-three cone point. Independently rebuilt n=4 and n=5 distance-threshold complexes and exact F2 ranks; H2 ranks 4 and 10, n=5 1413 nonempty faces. The all-n result rests on the chain/attachment proof, not the n=4,5 calculations.
